description: This is an exterior staircase leading up to an entrance. The stairs are made of rough-hewn stone or concrete, showing signs of wear and weathering. The steps are wide and appear to be in multiple tiers. To the right of the stairs, there is a metal railing. The entrance area features a weathered wooden door with some graffiti on it, and a covered porch area supported by columns. The overall impression is one of age and disrepair, suggesting it is part of an older building, possibly abandoned or neglected.
